DeleteConfirmDialog.title: Delete project
DeleteConfirmDialog.warning: If the project was previously public, references cited by others will continue to be referenced and will not be actually deleted.
DeleteConfirmDialog.deleteServerInfo: After deletion, users who previously referenced this project will still be able to continue using it.
DeleteConfirmDialog.deleteLocalInfo: This operation will delete both the server and local files and cannot be restored.
